title: LIVE NOW: META & TESLA REPORT EARNINGS 2026
speaker: Ricky Gutierrez

macro_themes.view: Markets tend to de-risk right before major earnings; staying in cash or trimming lets you take advantage of whatever happens.
Meta's capex guidance is the key: too much spend could sink Meta, too little could hit neocloud names like NBIS and CoreWeave.
Irrational markets support story stocks, but eventually fundamentals will matter.

calls.condition: Post-earnings: shorted the gap-up as an overbought reversal; would trim near an oversold level; careful if 720 support breaks.
calls.reason: Before the report he expected Meta to pump; after a 4.8% gap-up he shorted 100 shares (~$71k) as a small overbought-reversal trade while staying a long-term holder.
calls.quote: Small position. Opening up 25 shares short as Meta gaps up 4.8%.

calls.reason: Expected Tesla to miss; calls the car business fading, demand low, P/E ~400 and Optimus/robotaxi still unproven.
calls.quote: I don't think Tesla will hit their their earnings expectation. I think Tesla it it is now a a fading business

calls.condition: Waiting for BTC to actively drop for confirmation; plans to close the short before the close.
calls.reason: Intraday overbought reversal with gap-down potential; calls MSTR a dilutive, worthless company that crashes when Bitcoin falls.
calls.quote: This is an overbought reversal. I see it as that. I see some gap down potential.

calls.reason: Attractive at these prices but a leveraged AI-infrastructure bet (OpenAI exposure, Ellison leverage); sentiment and direction currently very weak.
calls.quote: at these prices, I do find it to be attractive. But direction and market sentiment are very important

calls.reason: Overhyped with no revenue expected until ~2030; fundamentals will eventually matter, though oversold levels may attract some investors.

notes: Live from 12:40 p.m. Arizona (15:40 ET) into the after-hours Meta/Tesla reports. Meta short-term bearish reflects his post-earnings short trade; pre-report he said 'I think that it will pump'. META entry approximate (~713 breakout area; $71k for 100 shares). SpaceX ticker assumed SPCX. MU, IBM and the Nasdaq were mentioned only in passing.
